PRODUCT OVERVIEW

Purpose-Built Container Transport · Two or Three Axles · I-Beam Chassis · Ports and Logistics

The EHJ9400TJZE is one of Hubei Ouyang Jude's core container transport models, with an I-beam frame and twist locks securing standard 20 / 40 / 45 ft containers for ports, logistics parks, rail transfers and cross-border transport.

Choose from Three-Axle Chassis(13.95/10.7m) /Two-Axle Chassis(13.95/9m) /Chassis Assembly(11.488m) /Open-Top Container Version (20 ft). Choose 12, 16 or 20 twist locks; repositionable front locks support twin-container loads. Xiangqi is listed in China's vehicle type-approval catalog and has an established container transport presence.

FEATURES

Key Features

Five Design Features · Purpose-Built for Containers

01 FRAME

I-Beam Main Frame

The frame uses welded I-beam longitudinal and crossmembers for low tare weight and container loads up to 36 t under sustained operation.

02 LOCKS

Multiple Twist-Lock Positions

Available as 12 / 16 / 20 twist locks accommodate 20 / 40 / 45 ft containers or twin 20 ft loads, with optional repositionable front locks.

03 VERSIONS

Chassis Layout Options

Available as Three-Axle Chassis (popular lengths: 10.7 / 13.95 m), or Two-Axle Chassis(9/13.95m) /Chassis Assembly(11.488m) /Open-Top Container (20 ft) configurations.

04 AXLES

FUWA Heavy-Duty Axles

FUWA 13 t / 16 t heavy-duty axles with mechanical or air suspension suit frequent starts and stops in port operations.

05 SAFETY

Dual Braking + ABS

Air brakes (4 dual + 2 single chambers) and KOMEE ABS provide controlled braking on descents with loaded containers, in line with the GB 7258 national standard.
